items.text: Skill-led routes come first because you can sell the work and set the price.
Maths graduates have eight real routes.
The routes are ordered by how far income and reach can grow, not by prestige or exam difficulty.
Rank-based and exam-led routes come last because pay is fixed and few people reach the top.
Maths is the hard part of this field: linear algebra, probability and optimisation.

blocks.heading: Mathematics Career Options
rows: Open to anyone who has appeared in or passed 10+2, or is studying a higher course. A pass is valid for 3 years for student membership (IAI notice, 2021). December 2026: fee Rs 500, exam 5 December 2026. IAI also grants exemptions from some papers for ISI Kolkata coursework, depending on modules and grades.
Yes. The entrance is open to every maths graduate. The papers that follow are the hard part.
Only if your BSc carried statistics, or you add an MSc in statistics. A pure maths marksheet can fail this entry requirement.
Phase 1 has 200 marks, Phase 2 has 240 and the interview 75.
Not with a BSc. An MSc in maths works only with the statistics diploma added.
A degree with statistics as a subject, or 60% in maths at Class 12, as reported by exam-guide sites. Read the SSC notice for the live rule.
Often yes through the Class 12 maths route. Check the current notice.
A master's degree plus a pass in the joint CSIR-UGC NET, Mathematical Sciences paper. The JRF stage has an age cap, so read the current bulletin.
No. A BSc alone does not reach this door.
Postgraduate degree in mathematics in first division with NET. Age up to 28. Stipend Rs 37,000 a month plus HRA. Walk-in interview, no right to absorption.
No. It needs the master's and NET.
